roles.title: Software Development Intern
points: Architected an end-to-end automation platform that replaced a fully manual, multi-system code-merge workflow — spanning issue tracking, build systems, code review, and merge reporting — with a self-driving pipeline that runs for about $2.17 per batch, freeing engineers from hours of manual coordination to focus on higher-priority work.

Built an AI-powered developer tool that lets engineers trigger approved CI/CD and infrastructure operations — environment checks, credential retrieval, build repair, deployments — through natural-language requests, backed by a secure server enforcing an operation allowlist, input validation, and credential redaction.
Designed a fair-distribution queue for long-running build jobs across parallel build slots, using lock-protected persisted state to eliminate race conditions between concurrent requests.

Built a crash-safe, durable workflow engine with SQLite-backed state, idempotent retries, and automatic reconciliation, guaranteeing no duplicate bug reports, builds, or submissions if a run is interrupted or restarted.
Added a human-in-the-loop Slack escalation flow with strict verification (correct engineer, channel, and timing) that safely pauses automation on edge cases and resumes only after human confirmation.
